summary: Daughter of Addison F. Pringle and Catherine E. Heffernan who married William Leacacos in New York City in 1915; John's great-grand-aunt.
bio: Genevieve Pringle was born in May 1893 in Pennsylvania, a daughter of Addison F. Pringle and Catherine E. Heffernan and a sister of John's great-grandmother Florence Pringle. In 1910 she was living with her parents in the Plymouth and Larksville area. On 6 May 1915 she married William Leacacos in New York City. A daughter was born to the couple at Wilkes-Barre in 1922, so they had returned to the Wyoming Valley by then, and she was later known as Genevieve Pringle Leacacos.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh (1910 Plymouth census list of Catherine Heffernan Pringle's children)

researchNotes:
Child of Addison F. Pringle and Catherine E. Heffernan, born about 1893, listed in the 1910 census (Plymouth/Larksville) household. No further research done.

FamilySearch gives her birth as May 1893 (from the 1900 census) and records her marriage to William Leacacos in New York City on 6 May 1915, indexed in the NYC marriage records. It lists a daughter born at Wilkes-Barre in 1922, so the couple lived in the Wyoming Valley afterwards. A GenealogyBank obituary index entry (1980-2015) under 'Genevieve Pringle Leacacos' is attached but was not read ([R4-S1]). The site's note that 'Joseph Vincent married in New York City in 1915' probably belongs to Genevieve.
